title: What emotions reveal about patient safety: GPT-4-based sentiment and emotion analysis of 11056 German CIRS medical reports (2005-2024)

live_model.evidence: Methods: model version "2024-04-09, accessed March 2025" with temperature setting; "GPT-4 was prompted in a zero-shot ..." (Methods, online supplemental material 2).

prompt.location: online supplemental material 2 (full narrative prompts), not in the main text

claim.metric: mean emotion scores per report group (descriptive)
claim.location: Table 1 (group differences by specialty and care type), Table 3 (feedback presence)

data.source: CIRS reports are publicly readable online (German critical incident reporting system); no identifier list or extraction snapshot is provided

notes: The output is a descriptive emotion analysis without an accuracy against a reference label, and the prompts are only in the supplement; 11,056 long reports would also exceed the low-cost range.
